components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The direct action used to open, run, retry, or regenerate a record.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 17px; color: var(--paper-bright); background: var(--blue); border: 1px solid var(--blue); border-radius: 0; font: 800 1rem/1.2 'Faraday Sans', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); border-color: var(--blue-dark); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Rail Button
components.description: A secondary session action on the dark specimen rail.
components.css: .ds-button-rail { padding: 10px 12px; color: #d8e0de; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #667573; border-radius: 0; font: 400 1rem/1.2 'Faraday Sans', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-rail:hover { color: white; background: var(--rail-raised); border-color: #a9b6b3; } .ds-button-rail:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Instrument Field
components.description: A literal text or numeric field with paper fill and structural stroke.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink); font: 800 0.8rem/1.2 'Faraday Sans', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-field { min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 11px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-bright); border: 1px solid #66716f; border-radius: 0; font: inherit; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field:disabled { color: #6d7776; background: #c8ccc7; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Active Workflow Step
components.description: A numbered cobalt station in the three-stage review path.
components.css: .ds-step { min-height: 65px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 15px; color: var(--paper-bright); background: var(--blue); font: 600 1rem/1.2 'Faraday Sans', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-step span { width: 20px; height: 20px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; font-size: 0.7rem; } .ds-step:hover { background: var(--blue-dark); } .ds-step:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Specimen Choice
components.description: A numbered document row with a mineral-paper selected state.
components.css: .ds-specimen { width: 230px; min-height: 67px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px 1fr; grid-template-rows: auto auto; gap: 3px 9px; padding: 11px 12px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--paper); text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Faraday Sans', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; } .ds-specimen b { grid-row: 1 / 3; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-specimen span { align-self: end; font-weight: 800; } .ds-specimen small { color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-specimen:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Verified Status
components.description: A square uppercase record state with explicit text.
components.css: .ds-status { width: fit-content; display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; color: white; background: var(--green); border-radius: 0; font: 800 0.7rem/1.3 'Faraday Sans', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.035em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Evidence Finding
components.description: A full-width source-linked finding with a cobalt pressed state.
components.css: .ds-finding { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(130px, .34fr) 1fr; gap: 4px 16px; padding: 17px 18px; color: white; background: var(--blue); border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; text-align: left; font-family: 'Faraday Sans', 'Arial Narrow', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-finding strong { grid-row: 1 / 3; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-finding span, .ds-finding q { color: #e1ebf8; } .ds-finding:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--yellow); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Faraday looks like calibrated review equipment rather than a generic compliance dashboard. Mineral-white reading surfaces sit inside dark instrument rails, while ruled fields preserve the visible boundary between hostile evidence, trusted policy, and consequential action. The system is dense but never cryptic: every active state, source, and status must remain legible during a short operational review.
keyCharacteristics: Square, ruled surfaces with no decorative rounding.
Cobalt for location, navigation, and selected evidence.
Danger orange only for hostile content, consequential risk, and errors.
Condensed operational typography paired with monospace evidence records.
Persistent provenance and explicit boundaries between Reader, Planner, and policy corpus.

rules.name: The Signal Separation Rule
rules.body: Cobalt means location or selection, orange means danger or failure, and the two never exchange roles.

rules.name: The Literal Data Rule
rules.body: Reserve monospace for source text, structured output, arguments, and measurements; interface labels remain condensed sans.

rules.name: The Joined Surface Rule
rules.body: Related records share one ruled container; do not scatter them into floating cards.

rules.name: The Paper First Rule
rules.body: Add shadow only when a whole paper workspace must separate from the canvas, never to decorate individual rows.

dos: Do preserve visible separation between hostile document text, trusted policy, and Planner-safe records.
Do use joined ruled grids for comparisons and dense evidence.
Do keep every interactive state understandable without relying on color alone.
Do keep top-right workflow navigation and a visible mobile equivalent.
Do honor reduced motion and maintain keyboard focus through dynamic updates.
donts: Don't use rounded dashboard cards, ornamental gradients, glass effects, or decorative icon tiles.
Don't use danger orange for ordinary navigation or selection.
Don't use monospace as a general interface costume.
Don't hide policy provenance, evidence anchors, or the Reader and Planner boundary.
Don't replace semantic controls with glyph-only interactions.
